name: g9-Battle-Scene
description: Fork of g2-Battle-Scene, tightly coupled to g9-battle-engine-beta -- unlike that mod (a standalone library, left untouched), this one owns no combat rules of its own at all. Turn resolution calls mod.exports.resolveTurnActions on g9-battle-engine-beta (STAB/Tera/Protect/damage/accuracy/sub-effects all live there, per the standing 'combat logic lives in g9-battle-engine-beta only' rule), while EXP/catch call the real native Gen 2 primitives (Battle:awardExperience, src/battle/gen2/Catching.lua) directly rather than a hand-ported copy. Same named battle-layout index (layouts/<name>.lua presets) and rendering as g2-Battle-Scene; a calling mod picks a preset by name and supplies the battler roster via mod.exports.pushLayoutBattle.
